note: Wikimedia Commons, “Cuthbert and Boisil.jpg”; artist as recorded there: AnonymousUnknown author — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons describes the miniature in British Library Yates Thompson MS 26, Bede's prose Life of St Cuthbert, as Cuthbert's meeting with Boisil at Melrose. The house named in the description is this folder's, and Bede is the source for the prior of Melrose who died in 664, the year this folder records. He is shown with Cuthbert, not alone. Commons describes it: A miniature in the British Library Yates Thomson MS 26, Bede's Prose Life of St Cuthbert, depicting Cuthbert's meeting with Boisil at Melrose
